concepts.title: Mixed directed port members
concepts.subject: Mixed::Boundary
constraints: One square boundary can contain attribute, event and operation members together.
Arrowheads show data/event direction; an outward arrow means provides and inward means requires.
A ball marks a provided operation; an open socket marks a required operation. These are member glyphs, not port types.
A compact double arrow summarizes opposite data/event directions only; expanded labels retain each member name and type.
Reversed flips every direction, arrow and operation glyph; geometry never adds members or routes.
concepts.rationale: A canonical source-backed projection; geometry is separate from semantics.
